I'm trying to figure out the rule about keeping the unique shape - looking at how the pluses and diagonal shapes differ across examples, and which one gets retained in each case seems tied to which shape appears distinctly rather than repeated.

Checking example 2, the shapes at rows 1-2 and 12-13 both form the same down-right diagonal pattern, so uniqueness by shape isn't quite the rule - it seems to actually be about keeping whichever shape sits lowest in the grid.

In example 3, the kept shape has its lowest row at 9, compared to 3 and 7 for the others, so bottom-most position does seem to be the consistent pattern to apply to the test case.
